factChecks.briefClaim: At least eight LPG tankers left the Gulf of Oman since mid-July.
factChecks.note: Reuters quoting Shelley. UANI October 16 instead says about nine LPG and naphtha tankers. Hulls are not listed.

factChecks.briefClaim: Those LPG cargoes were about 4.1 million barrels.
factChecks.note: Shelley estimate via Reuters. Absent from the UANI October 16 page. Not a measurement.

factChecks.briefClaim: A jet-fuel tanker reached Myanmar in September.
factChecks.note: SynMax via Reuters. Name, IMO, and port are UNKNOWN.

factChecks.briefClaim: Ship-to-ship transfers occurred near Oman, including Shinas and Sohar.
factChecks.note: Some tankers, unnamed. No coordinates. Not tied to the September 4 named transfer.
Most cargoes to Malaysia EOPL for further STS, per Shelley. China is likely, not established.

factChecks.briefClaim: Six of the LPG tankers and the jet-fuel tanker were already sanctioned.
factChecks.note: Reuters says they are under US sanctions and, separately, that 17 vessels were sanctioned last week. Already, and which hulls, are not stated.

factChecks.briefClaim: Transiting the area does not prove blockade evasion, because vessels can be permitted through and AIS can be spoofed.
factChecks.note: Military official: individual review and possible humanitarian permission. Treasury spokesperson: spoofing or false identity when loading. Not a finding about these hulls.

factChecks.briefClaim: Brent touched 110 and settled at 109.86. WTI settled at 101.41.
factChecks.note: Same figures in Xinhua and TokenPost. Exchange file not read. A social post with different closes was ignored.

factChecks.briefClaim: DOE issued an RFP to exchange up to 17 million SPR barrels.
factChecks.note: Reuters citing DOE. No matching item on the DOE news index retrieved 2026-10-17. SPR exchange index did not render a document list.

factChecks.briefClaim: That RFP is part of the existing 172 million barrel commitment, not an addition.
factChecks.note: DOE documents establish the 172 million commitment and a September 29 RFP for up to 40 million. Reuters places the 17 million inside that deal. DOE text for this 17 million notice was not found.

factChecks.briefClaim: The 17 million barrel RFP is not yet contracted.
factChecks.note: Inferred from an RFP with no award in the article. Not a DOE sentence. The October 10 hurricane exchange, up to 4 million for named companies, is a different action.
